openQuestions.title: Force a style flush after the timed class change, or explain why not
openQuestions.detail: frames-to-run start() toggles the 'lit' class without a getComputedStyle() flush afterwards, so the transition is only created at the next style recalc, which Chrome runs after animation frame callbacks. A "1 frame late" reading can therefore come from style-resolution timing, not from transitionrun dispatch deferral — the frames-to-run run reported the plain setTimeout task as "1 iteration late" too, which is consistent with that artefact. Either flush style immediately after the timed change (as the reset path already does) or document why the unflushed case is the right measurement, then re-verify on a Chrome build known to carry the fix.
